method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks slip in Asia as oil and yields climb
Equities.reason: Higher oil and rising yields are a classic headwind for risk assets; this headline signals cross-regional risk-off pressure that weighs on broad equity sentiment in Asia and beyond.

Equities.title: US Stocks and Treasuries Fall as Oil Pushes Higher: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: US equities and bonds selling together with rising oil points to weaker risk appetite and higher real rates; negative for broad market regime and liquidity-sensitive growth names.

Equities.title: Nvidia launches record $150bn share buyback
Equities.summary: Chipmaker’s plan to repurchase stock comes as share price gains have slowed this year
Equities.reason: Very large buyback from the AI leader is a market-structure event — boosts buyback/funding narrative, supports mega-cap leadership and risk appetite; high-impact positive for equities.

Equities.title: Nvidia releases software platform to stop AI agents from misbehaving
Equities.summary: Nvidia says its new software could have prevented OpenAI's Hugging Face incident.
Equities.reason: Product addressing AI safety reduces operational/regulatory tail risk for the AI ecosystem and modestly supports sector sentiment and investor confidence in hyperscalers.

Equities.title: US and China agree $60bn low tariff regime for goods from foie gras to camels
Equities.summary: Board of trade will lower levies on non-sensitive goods as superpowers seek to ease tensions
Equities.reason: Trade détente between the US and China is a meaningful macro tailwind for global cyclicals and EM/China exposures — supports risk-on narrative and earnings outlook for exporters.

Equities.title: Chinese Stocks Hit One-Year Low as Chip, Optical Firms Slide
Equities.reason: Sector-led selloff in Chinese tech/chips points to localized weakness and increased volatility for China equities, pressuring global risk sentiment given China’s market size.

Equities.title: Global Funds End Underweight Position on China After Four Years
Equities.reason: Institutional re-entry into China is a structural flow that could support EM/China equities into the medium term; offsets some near-term weakness and increases relevance of China for global allocations.

Equities.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
Equities.summary: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.
Equities.reason: Large litigation verdict against a mega-cap tech name adds headline risk and could weigh on sector multiples and investor sentiment, though outcome may be appealed.

Equities.title: Could A.I. Safety Risks Derail the Sector’s I.P.O. Prospects?
Equities.reason: Growing focus on AI safety and potential regulatory/PR headwinds could dampen forward IPO activity and valuations for AI-native firms; modest negative for sentiment.

Equities.title: Global AI trade could revive after recent pullback, J.P. Morgan says
Equities.reason: Selloff in AI-related names may be followed by renewed investor interest; JPMorgan view supports a constructive medium-term technical/flow narrative for the sector.

Equities.title: Wall Street money takes back over from small investors as driving force of the stock market
Equities.summary: One firm sees a "reasonably constructive signal for risk appetite" among institutional investors.
Equities.reason: Return of institutional leadership in flows is a constructive signal for sustained risk appetite and could stabilize market breadth relative to retail-driven volatility.

Equities.title: UK housebuilders stocks rally on homebuyer loan revival
Equities.reason: Sector-specific catalyst (loan revival) is boosting UK homebuilders and offers a localized positive equity narrative for domestic cyclicals.

Equities.title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
Equities.summary: Economists expect Beijing to lean harder on stimulus to stabilize corporate profitability, as consolidation accelerates in sectors facing sluggish demand and fierce competition.
Equities.reason: Weak corporate profit growth raises near-term downside risk for China equities; however it increases the probability of policy stimulus which may be a medium-term support.

Rates.title: US Treasuries: Yields hit multi-year highs – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: The Deutsche Bank Early Morning Reid details a sharp rise in US Treasury yields, with the 10-year reaching its highest level since 2007 and the 30-year touching levels last seen in 2004. The move is driven by strong data and increased odds of a Federal Reserve
Rates.reason: Clear, high-impact rates story: large Treasury yield move driven by strong data and higher Fed hike odds. Direction negative for bond prices (yields up). High relevance due to multi-year highs and domestic policy transmission.

Rates.title: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here
Rates.summary: The benchmark yield has climbed to a 19-year high, fueled by sticky inflation, heavy bond issuance and an AI-fueled investment boom.
Rates.reason: Synthesis piece explaining drivers of the strong Treasury move (sticky inflation, issuance). Implicates sustained upward pressure on yields -> negative for bond prices; important context so given elevated relevance.

Rates.title: Bond sell-off deepens as oil price rises
Rates.summary: Brent crude jumps and 10-year Treasury yield surpasses 5.2% as hopes for US-Iran agreement fade
Rates.reason: Links geopolitical risk and oil-driven risk premium to a material Treasury selloff and 10yr >5% — directly negative for bonds with strong market-moving transmission; high relevance.

Rates.title: Treasury yields edge higher amid pressure on global government bonds
Rates.summary: Treasury yields edged higher on Monday as investors look ahead to fresh economic data releases this week.
Rates.reason: Routine market update showing continued upward drift in yields ahead of key data — negative for bond prices but more incremental, hence medium relevance.

Rates.title: Key US Data This Week Seen Bolstering Case for October Rate Hike
Rates.reason: Forward-looking piece signalling data-driven lift in Fed hike odds and therefore higher yields; directly relevant to rates outlook and medium-high relevance.

Rates.title: US Dollar Index: Strongest G10 currency performance – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid and team note that the US Dollar was the strongest-performing G10 currency last week as Treasury yields surged and markets repriced a more hawkish Federal Reserve.
Rates.reason: FX story that explicitly links USD strength to surging Treasury yields and repriced Fed policy — included for its direct causal link to the rates move (moderate relevance for pure rates narrative).

Rates.title: BoE’s Ramsden warns upside inflation risks may spur rate hikes
Rates.summary: Bank of England (BoE) Deputy Governor Dave Ramsden said on Monday that risks to the inflation outlook have become increasingly tilted to the upside, according to Reuters.
Rates.reason: Central-bank official flagging upside inflation risk and potential additional rate hikes — negative for UK bond prices and contributes to global higher-for-longer rates narrative.

Rates.title: Japan’s Two-Year Bond Yield Nears 2% as BOJ Rate Hike Bets Mount
Rates.reason: Regional rates move showing BOJ tightening expectations lifting short-term yields — supports the cross-market narrative of global repricing of policy and higher yields.

Rates.title: Debt-hungry AI companies face increased risk as bond yields spike
Rates.summary: The AI infrastructure buildout shows no sign of slowing, but the surge in Treasury yields means it's at least going to cost more.
Rates.reason: Highlights economic/credit transmission of higher Treasury yields — increased funding costs for corporate capex. Negative for credit and funding-sensitive sectors; moderate relevance to overall rates stress.

Rates.title: Higher Bond Yields Are Raising Doubts About Europe’s Stock Rally
Rates.reason: Narrative linking rising yields to equity market vulnerability in Europe — reinforces macro significance of the bond selloff and is directly relevant to rates-driven risk sentiment.

Rates.title: South Korea’s Three-Year Yield Rises to Highest Level Since 2022
Rates.reason: Local-market rates move consistent with the broader global trend of rising yields; included as a regional datapoint with modest relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar struggles as US-Canada yield gap widens
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its rally on Monday as diverging monetary policy outlooks between the Federal Reserve (Fed) and the Bank of Canada (BoC) keep the US Dollar (USD) favoured, outweighing support for the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) from higher Oil price
FX.reason: Clear USD-strength narrative driven by widening US-Canada yield differentials. Direct FX transmission (USD/CAD rally) makes this a high-relevance, negative signal for the USD-centric FX basket (non-USD currencies weakening).

FX.title: Australian Dollar holds steady as RBA rate hike expectations balance elevated US yields
FX.summary: AUD/USD trades around 0.7020 on Monday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day.
FX.reason: Balanced cross-pressure: RBA hike expectations offset by elevated US yields. Low net directional impact for the USD-centric FX basket; technical/near-term stability signals only (lower relevance).

FX.title: US Dollar: Support from yields and growth – BBH
FX.summary: Elias Haddad at Brown Brothers Harriman argues the Dollar can keep benefiting from widening US-G6 rate differentials and higher US real yields.
FX.reason: Firm macro view that higher US real yields and widening rate differentials support the USD. Broad-market, multi-factor support for USD strength — high relevance and a material negative for the non-USD FX basket.

FX.title: Oil: Higher prices drive yields and Dollar – MUFG
FX.summary: Lee Hardman at MUFG highlights that Oil has been one of the biggest movers, with prices rising back towards recent highs around USD110/barrel.
FX.reason: Commodity-driven channel into FX: rising oil lifts yields and the USD. Indirect but explicit USD-strength transmission (negative for the USD-centric FX basket) with moderate relevance.

FX.title: British Pound gains as several BoE members warn of upside inflation risks
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) trades higher against its major currency peers, except the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Monday. In the European trade, the British currency is up 0.13% to near 1.3256 against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: BoE hawkish comments supporting GBP vs USD — a direct positive for the non-USD side of the FX basket. Mid-level relevance given regional scope but clear FX transmission.

FX.title: Indian Rupee falls sharply as oil prices rally
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) starts the week on a negative note against the US Dollar (USD) due to significant gains in oil prices over the weekend. As of writing, the USD/INR pair is up 0.18% to near 95.99.
FX.reason: Oil-driven EM FX weakening: higher oil pushes USD/INR up. Relevant to EM currency pressure and USD strength transmission, but EM-specific so slightly lower relevance than G10 moves.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Slips below nine-day EMA, 157.00
FX.summary: USD/JPY extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around 156.90 during the European hours on Monday. The currency pair is moving forward within a symmetrical triangle, which indicates a period of market consolidation, where neither buyers nor
FX.reason: Technical note: USD/JPY losing ground (JPY strengthening). Technical/price-forecast pieces have capped relevance; positive for the non-USD side but limited market-moving weight.

FX.title: EUR/USD: Consensus shifts lower on Dollar resilience – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Kit Juckes at Societe Generale notes that EUR/USD forecasts have been repeatedly revised down as Dollar strength persists. While consensus has moved from 1.20 to 1.16 and Societe Generale now sees 1.15, client discussions suggest markets are even more Dollar-b
FX.reason: Analyst consensus moving lower explicitly because of Dollar resilience — direct FX impact (EUR weakness/USD strength). Mid-to-high relevance for EURUSD outlook and the broader USD-centric narrative.

FX.title: US Dollar: Breakout risks versus fading outlook – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale’s Kit Juckes argues that while the longer-term outlook for the Dollar is deteriorating due to US politics and changing global savings patterns, the short-term picture remains constructive.
FX.reason: Nuanced view: short-term USD constructive despite weaker long-term backdrop. Short-term USD-support message is relevant to near-term FX positioning (negative for non-USD currencies).

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BOJ back-to-back hike risk – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets team flags potential historic tightening by the Bank of Japan (BOJ). Former BOJ director Momma sees another 25 basis point hike as a real possibility, which would be the first back-to-back move in decades.
FX.reason: Potential BOJ tightening is a major FX-native, central-bank shock that would support JPY. High relevance given the historic nature of possible back-to-back hikes and direct USD/JPY transmission (positive for non-USD basket).

FX.title: Japan’s Mimura reiterates fears US-Japan joint intervention
FX.summary: Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said on ​that markets should take at face value the "very ‌clear" message Tokyo and Washington delivered last week on the Yen, signalling his resolve to act against excessive falls ​in the currency, Reuters report.
FX.reason: Explicit intervention signaling from top currency diplomat raises credible upside for JPY (direct FX intervention risk). High relevance because official warnings materially affect USD/JPY positioning and market risk pricing.

FX.title: USD/JPY: Intervention risk caps upside – BBH
FX.summary: BBH’s Elias Haddad highlights that the Dollar is broadly firmer, but intervention warnings from Japanese officials are supporting the Japanese Yen.
FX.reason: Intervention warnings are preventing further USD/JPY upside and supporting JPY. Direct FX message with above-average relevance given official commentary on intervention risk.

Commodities.title: Gold slides 3% as traders weigh Fed outlook, latest US-Iran developments
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) remains under strong selling pressure on Monday, down nearly 3% as elevated Oil prices keep inflation concerns elevated, reinforcing expectations of further Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hikes.
Commodities.reason: Precious metals hit by rising US yields and stronger Fed hike bets — direct negative for non-yielding gold. The move is large (near 3%) and macro-driven, so high relevance for the gold market.

Commodities.title: Silver price plunges as elevated US yields, firm Dollar pressure XAG/USD
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) falls sharply on Monday, losing 4.53% on the day to trade around $61.40 at the time of writing. The precious metal faces heavy selling pressure as elevated United States (US) Treasury yields and growing expectations of further interest rate hi
Commodities.reason: Silver under larger downside pressure than gold due to both precious-metal selloff and strong US yields / firm USD. Big intraday drop makes this high-relevance, negative for silver prices.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil extends gains nearing $95.00 as Trump rejects Hormuz reopening plan
Commodities.summary: Oil appreciates firmly on Monday, following US President Donald Trump's refusal of Tehran’s latest proposal to cease hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Oil barrel is trading at $94.60 at the time of writ
Commodities.reason: Clear geopolitical-driven oil rally (Strait of Hormuz / US-Iran tensions) pushing WTI toward $95 — strong supply-risk impulse and market-moving for crude, high relevance and bullish for oil.

Commodities.title: Brent: Oil climbs on Middle East tensions – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Early Morning Reid highlights renewed upside in Brent Oil as US-Iran negotiations show little progress and Iran refuses to soften conditions on reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note reinforcing the same Middle East geopolitical upside for Brent — supportive but commentary-grade (slightly lower relevance than front-line price move).

Commodities.title: Oil prices rise as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.summary: Oil prices jumped on Monday after U.S. President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian peace proposal aimed at ending the conflict.
Commodities.reason: Mainstream confirmation of a geopolitical-driven oil price jump — reinforces the dominant bullish oil narrative and has material market relevance for crude and refined product prices.

Commodities.title: Saudi Arabia’s Key Oil Pipeline Starts Exports After Repairs
Commodities.reason: Pipeline restart implies additional Saudi exports/supply normalization — partial offset to geopolitically-driven risk premium. Moderately relevant negative signal for oil.

Commodities.title: Henry Hub natural gas prices this summer were 6% lower than last summer
Commodities.summary: The Henry Hub natural gas spot price averaged $2.93 per million British thermal units from June through August, 6% less than the same period last year. Prices were lower this summer despite exceptionally hot weather that increased electricity demand for air co
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing lower summer Henry Hub prices points to weaker gas fundamentals vs. prior year — modestly bearish for natural gas given lower spot/risk premium.

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.reason: Federal Reserve proposals to create a supervisory framework for payment stablecoin issuers materially reduce regulatory uncertainty and signal potential mainstreaming/legitimacy for stablecoins — positive adoption/regulatory clarity for crypto.

Crypto.title: Solana ETFs draw record $188 million in a week as Bitwise takes two-thirds of inflows
Crypto.reason: Significant ETF inflows into a non-Bitcoin/ETH crypto product indicate growing institutional/retail channel adoption for tokenized investment products — positive for altcoin liquidity and market structure.

Crypto.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
Crypto.reason: Performance/settlement upgrades improve Solana's utility and institutional attractiveness; positive technical progress though more of a protocol-level signal (moderate relevance).

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
Crypto.reason: Loss of a pro-crypto SEC commissioner raises regulatory uncertainty and reduces an internal counterweight at the SEC — net negative for regulatory outlook and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Senate Investigation Finds Rampant Use of Tether’s Stablecoin by Iranian Regime
Crypto.reason: Findings of sanctioned-state use of a major stablecoin heighten geopolitical and sanction-related regulatory risks for stablecoins and counterparties — materially negative for stablecoin trust and regulatory scrutiny.

Crypto.title: Chainlink updates its crypto bridge tech months after a $292 million hack at a rival exposed risks
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level security upgrades to bridge tech directly address a systemic vulnerability highlighted by large hacks — positive for reducing systemic counterparty/bridge risk over time.

Crypto.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP beyond reach of freeze controls
Crypto.reason: Large-scale thefts and movement of funds beyond freeze controls undermine on-chain custody assurances and increase operational risk — negative for market trust and exchange risk premia.

Crypto.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
Crypto.reason: Stablecoin issuers intervening to freeze stolen funds indicates centralized remediation capabilities that can limit losses and support market stability — modestly positive for risk containment.

Crypto.title: Crypto-friendly institution Franklin Templeton brings its tokenized collateral service to Bybit
Crypto.reason: An established institutional manager offering tokenized collateral services on a major exchange signals practical onboarding of traditional finance into crypto infrastructure — material positive for institutionalization.

Crypto.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
Crypto.reason: Exchange parent investment into broader financial infrastructure strengthens on-ramps and service layers for crypto markets — positive for market depth and institutional use cases.

Crypto.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
Crypto.reason: Opinion noting rapid tokenization momentum underscores adoption tailwinds (tokenized assets, collateral, securities) — positive structural narrative despite regulatory lag.

Crypto.title: How months of work on the Clarity Act all fell apart
Crypto.reason: Failure to progress a legislative clarity effort increases regulatory uncertainty and delays durable legal frameworks for crypto — negative for policy certainty.

Crypto.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
Crypto.reason: Court rulings extending state regulatory reach over prediction markets set a precedent that can constrain decentralized/novel market products — modestly negative for innovation and legal risk.

Crypto.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
Crypto.reason: Long-horizon technical/architectural vision from a leading protocol figure signals ongoing product evolution and developer confidence — positive for Ethereum ecosystem narrative.
